_registry_meta.description: Business sector archetype-weight mapping. Reuses the planet -> archetype vocabulary already defined in jyotish/d10_archetypes.py (PLANET_ARCHETYPES / ARCHETYPE_NAMES) so business sector scoring can share the same domain_score()/scale_raw_support() math as career-field domain scoring. Each sector's weights must sum to 1.0 (validated by validate_business_rule_pack() in business_engine.py).
_registry_meta.archetype_family_note: archetype_family groups sectors that share a genuinely dominant planetary/archetype signature (same top-weighted archetype(s) + overlapping core_planets), derived directly from each sector's weights/core_planets above -- used by diversify_sector_ranking() (business_determination/sectors.py) so near-duplicate sectors driven by the same underlying chart signature don't crowd out genuinely distinct top matches in client-facing sector lists. One of the enum values validated by validate_business_rule_pack().
_registry_meta.capital_intensity_note: capital_intensity (LOW/MODERATE/HIGH, one of the enum values validated by validate_business_rule_pack()) is a standard, disclosed business/economics classification of how much fixed capital (land, plant, equipment, regulated facilities) a sector typically requires before it can generate revenue -- NOT an astrological claim, and not derived from the chart. Used by business_determination/sectors.py's capital-feasibility check (item 33 of the astrological-completeness audit, 'sector capital intensity is not formally matched to capital capacity') to flag, purely mechanically, when a chart's own capital_strategy_lean (BOOTSTRAP_FAVORED / EXTERNAL_CAPITAL_FAVORED / BALANCED / INSUFFICIENT_DATA, computed in scoring.py from H2/H9/H11 vs H6/H8/H12/H12-lord strength) appears mismatched against a candidate sector's typical capital requirement -- e.g. a BOOTSTRAP_FAVORED chart matched to a HIGH-capital-intensity sector. capital_intensity_basis is a one-line, human-readable rationale for each sector's tier, so the classification is auditable rather than an opaque label.

trading_commerce.label: Trading & Commerce
trading_commerce.capital_intensity_basis: Working-capital-driven (inventory financing, receivables) rather than fixed-asset heavy.

manufacturing_industrial.label: Manufacturing & Industrial
manufacturing_industrial.capital_intensity_basis: Plant, machinery, and industrial facilities are prerequisites before production/revenue.
manufacturing_industrial.notes: Audit fix: reassigned off the overcrowded mars_saturn_engineering_fieldops family (7 members pre-fix) into a narrower heavy-industrial-production sub-family shared only with automotive_transport_manufacturing.

real_estate_construction.label: Real Estate & Construction (Umbrella)
real_estate_construction.capital_intensity_basis: Land acquisition and construction capital are prerequisites before any unit is sellable/rentable.
real_estate_construction.notes: Audit fix: broadened (H4/H10 -> H4/H7/H10, +Venus) so this no longer duplicates construction_contracting's exact H4/H10 Mars-Saturn signature -- now genuinely spans both the build side (construction_contracting) and the sell/deal side (real_estate_development_brokerage) rather than being a stale copy of one of its own children.

consulting_professional_services.label: Consulting & Professional Services
consulting_professional_services.capital_intensity_basis: Primarily expertise/labor-based; minimal fixed assets needed to begin operating.

finance_investment.label: Finance & Investment
finance_investment.capital_intensity_basis: Requires a substantial capital base to lend, underwrite, or invest at meaningful scale.

hospitality_lifestyle.label: Hospitality & Lifestyle
hospitality_lifestyle.capital_intensity_basis: Property/build-out costs vary widely by format (boutique service vs. full-scale hospitality venue).

tech_startup.label: Technology Startup
tech_startup.capital_intensity_basis: Software/product development is comparatively low-capex versus physical-asset industries, though R&D runway still requires funding.

import_export_foreign_trade.label: Import/Export & Foreign Trade
import_export_foreign_trade.capital_intensity_basis: Working capital for inventory-in-transit and logistics, but not fixed industrial infrastructure.

agriculture_commodities.label: Agriculture & Commodities
agriculture_commodities.capital_intensity_basis: Land, irrigation/storage infrastructure, and equipment are prerequisites before harvest revenue.
agriculture_commodities.notes: Audit fix: reassigned off the overcrowded mars_saturn_engineering_fieldops family into its own singleton family -- agriculture's H4/H6 signature is genuinely distinct from industrial production or land-extraction sectors sharing the same two planets.

media_creative_business.label: Media & Creative Business
media_creative_business.capital_intensity_basis: Production costs scale with ambition but entry-level creative ventures are comparatively low-capex.

healthcare_wellness_venture.label: Healthcare & Wellness Venture
healthcare_wellness_venture.capital_intensity_basis: Clinical facilities, equipment, and regulatory compliance require substantial upfront capital.

family_business_continuation.label: Family Business Continuation
family_business_continuation.capital_intensity_basis: Typically inherits an existing capital base rather than starting from zero, but scale varies by the underlying business.

education_institutions.label: Education & Training Institutions
education_institutions.capital_intensity_basis: Physical/institutional infrastructure needed, though scale (tutoring vs. campus) varies widely.

logistics_transportation.label: Logistics & Transportation
logistics_transportation.capital_intensity_basis: Vehicle fleets, warehousing, and route infrastructure are substantial fixed-capital prerequisites.

retail.label: Retail
retail.capital_intensity_basis: Inventory and storefront/lease costs, but not heavy industrial fixed assets.

legal_services.label: Legal Services
legal_services.capital_intensity_basis: Primarily expertise/labor-based; minimal fixed assets needed to begin operating.
legal_services.notes: Audit fix: reassigned from jupiter_mercury_scholarship_commerce (a family name promising Mercury, which this sector's Jupiter-Saturn core_planets never included) to its own correctly-named family.

entertainment_sports.label: Entertainment & Sports (Umbrella)
entertainment_sports.capital_intensity_basis: Production/venue costs vary widely by format and scale.
entertainment_sports.notes: Audit fix: broadened (H5/H11 -> H5/H7/H11, +Venus) so this no longer duplicates sports_athletics_business's exact H5/H11 Sun-Mars signature, and now actually carries the Venus significator entertainment needs -- previously this sector had zero Venus despite being the entertainment/creative-adjacent parent.

energy_utilities.label: Energy & Utilities (Umbrella)
energy_utilities.capital_intensity_basis: Generation/distribution infrastructure requires very substantial upfront capital.
energy_utilities.notes: Audit fix: broadened (H6/H8 -> H4/H6/H8, +Mercury) and reassigned off mars_saturn_engineering_fieldops (a family name promising Mars, which this sector never had) so it now spans both energy_production_extraction (Sun-Saturn) and utilities_distribution_infrastructure (Saturn-Mercury) as a genuine umbrella instead of a mislabeled near-duplicate of the first.

pharma_biotech.label: Pharma & Biotech
pharma_biotech.capital_intensity_basis: R&D, regulated manufacturing, and compliance require substantial and sustained capital.

banking_lending_credit.label: Banking, Lending & Credit
banking_lending_credit.capital_intensity_basis: Regulatory capital reserves and large loan books are prerequisites for lending at scale.
banking_lending_credit.notes: Added: previously finance_investment (H2/H11, Jupiter-Mercury) covered wealth accumulation/asset management but had no 8th-house (leverage, other people's money, underwriting) significator -- banking/lending specifically needs it.

insurance_risk_underwriting.label: Insurance & Risk Underwriting
insurance_risk_underwriting.capital_intensity_basis: Reserve capital held against underwritten risk is a regulatory prerequisite.
insurance_risk_underwriting.notes: Added: distinct from healthcare_wellness_venture and finance_investment -- underwriting risk (6th=liability/disputes, 8th=risk/actuarial, 12th=loss) is its own classical signature.

it_services_outsourcing.label: IT Services & Outsourcing
it_services_outsourcing.capital_intensity_basis: Labor/service delivery model; minimal fixed assets beyond workstations and infrastructure access.
it_services_outsourcing.notes: Added: split conceptually from tech_startup -- steady service-delivery/outsourcing (Mercury-Saturn, H6 service + H10 karma) is a different chart signature from Rahu-driven disruptive/innovation startups.

ecommerce_digital_retail.label: E-commerce & Digital Retail
ecommerce_digital_retail.capital_intensity_basis: Inventory/logistics and platform-technology costs, lower than physical retail's storefront/lease overhead.
ecommerce_digital_retail.notes: Added: distinct from retail (no Rahu/digital-platform significator) and tech_startup (no commerce/trade significator) -- combines both.

fmcg_consumer_goods.label: FMCG & Consumer Goods
fmcg_consumer_goods.capital_intensity_basis: Distribution networks and brand-building costs; asset intensity moderate relative to heavy manufacturing.
fmcg_consumer_goods.notes: Added: fast-moving/daily consumer goods -- Moon (daily necessity, mass appeal) alongside Venus (brand/desirability), previously not represented as its own sector.

textiles_fashion_apparel.label: Textiles, Fashion & Apparel
textiles_fashion_apparel.capital_intensity_basis: Fabric/inventory and production-run costs; moderate relative to heavy industry.
textiles_fashion_apparel.notes: Added: previously absorbed into generic trading_commerce/retail with no design-forward (fashion) distinction. Audit fix: houses changed 3->5 (creative/design house, matching this sector's design-first weighting) after final validation found H3/H7+Mercury/Venus was an exact core_houses/core_planets duplicate of trading_commerce.

telecommunications.label: Telecommunications
telecommunications.capital_intensity_basis: Network infrastructure (towers, spectrum, cabling) requires very substantial upfront capital.
telecommunications.notes: Added: communication-infrastructure business, distinct from tech_startup (software/product) and media (content). Audit fix: added Saturn -- a HIGH capital_intensity/heavy-fixed-infrastructure sector had no structural/durability significator, inconsistent with how Saturn is used for every other HIGH-capital infrastructure sector in this registry.

mining_metals_extraction.label: Mining, Metals & Extraction
mining_metals_extraction.capital_intensity_basis: Extraction rights, heavy equipment, and site infrastructure are prerequisites before ore/output revenue.
mining_metals_extraction.notes: Added: split out of the old energy_utilities H6/H8 pairing -- extraction is more accurately anchored on H4 (land/subsurface resources) + H8 (hidden/transformative) than H6 (labor/service).

automotive_transport_manufacturing.label: Automotive & Transport Manufacturing
automotive_transport_manufacturing.capital_intensity_basis: Plant, tooling, and assembly-line infrastructure are prerequisites before unit revenue.
automotive_transport_manufacturing.notes: Added: split out of manufacturing_industrial as a named vertical (vehicles/transport equipment) rather than generic industrial production. Audit fix: houses changed 4/6->3/4 (3rd/4th are the classical vehicle/vahana houses) and Rahu added (modern automotive tech/EV significator) after final validation found H4/H6+Mars/Saturn was an exact core_houses/core_planets duplicate of agriculture_commodities.

beauty_personal_care.label: Beauty & Personal Care
beauty_personal_care.capital_intensity_basis: Product formulation/services scale with brand ambition but entry-level ventures are comparatively low-capex.
beauty_personal_care.notes: Added: previously had no dedicated sector -- distinct from hospitality_lifestyle (which is venue/experience-based) and healthcare_wellness_venture (which is clinical).

publishing_content_creation.label: Publishing & Content Creation
publishing_content_creation.capital_intensity_basis: Primarily intellectual-property/content-based; minimal fixed assets to begin operating.
publishing_content_creation.notes: Added: split out of media_creative_business -- publishing/authorship (Jupiter=knowledge authority) is a different signature from performance/visual media (Venus).

nonprofit_social_enterprise.label: Non-Profit & Social Enterprise
nonprofit_social_enterprise.capital_intensity_basis: Grant/donor-funded operating model; infrastructure needs vary widely by mission scale.
nonprofit_social_enterprise.notes: Added: dharma-and-service orientation (9th=dharma, 12th=charity/selfless expenditure) previously unrepresented among for-profit-framed sectors.

sports_athletics_business.label: Sports & Athletics Business
sports_athletics_business.capital_intensity_basis: Venue/training/franchise infrastructure costs vary widely by scale.
sports_athletics_business.notes: Split from Entertainment & Sports: the competitive/athletic side (leagues, academies, franchises) keeps the original Sun-Mars signature, which fits sports far better than creative/performance entertainment.

performing_arts_entertainment.label: Performing Arts & Entertainment
performing_arts_entertainment.capital_intensity_basis: Production/venue costs vary widely by format and scale.
performing_arts_entertainment.notes: Split from Entertainment & Sports: film/music/stage/performance ventures. Venus restored as core significator (aesthetics, audience appeal, performance arts) -- the original combined sector had no Venus at all, a gap flagged in astrologer review.

energy_production_extraction.label: Energy Production & Extraction
energy_production_extraction.capital_intensity_basis: Generation/extraction infrastructure requires very substantial upfront capital.
energy_production_extraction.notes: Split from Energy & Utilities: generation/extraction (oil, power plants, mining-adjacent energy) re-anchored on H4 (land/subsurface resource) + H8 (transformation/extraction) instead of the original H6, which read as a stretch for this activity.

utilities_distribution_infrastructure.label: Utilities & Distribution Infrastructure
utilities_distribution_infrastructure.capital_intensity_basis: Distribution grids/networks (power lines, water mains, pipelines) require very substantial upfront capital.
utilities_distribution_infrastructure.notes: Split from Energy & Utilities: distribution/network side (power grids, water utilities, pipelines) -- Mercury added for network/routing logic, distinguishing it from the extraction side above.

real_estate_development_brokerage.label: Real Estate Development & Brokerage
real_estate_development_brokerage.capital_intensity_basis: Land-banking and marketing costs, but brokerage itself is comparatively low-capex; development scales with project size.
real_estate_development_brokerage.notes: Split from Real Estate & Construction: sales/development/brokerage side. Venus added as core significator (property appeal, deal-making, buyer relationships) -- absent from the original construction-anchored Mars-Saturn pairing.

construction_contracting.label: Construction & Contracting
construction_contracting.capital_intensity_basis: Land acquisition and construction capital are prerequisites before any unit is sellable/rentable.
construction_contracting.notes: Split from Real Estate & Construction: the physical building/contracting execution side, keeping the original Mars-Saturn/land-labor signature unchanged.

spiritual_religious_occult_services.label: Spiritual, Religious & Occult Services
spiritual_religious_occult_services.capital_intensity_basis: Primarily practice/teaching-based; minimal fixed assets needed to begin operating.
spiritual_religious_occult_services.notes: Audit fix (gap #4): Ketu appeared in zero sectors of the prior 37-sector registry despite being a standard graha for moksha/spiritual practice, astrology, occult sciences, and alternative healing -- any chart with a dominant, well-placed Ketu had no sector to match against. H9 (dharma, guru, higher belief) + H12 (moksha, ashram, seclusion) is the classical house pairing for this domain.

cybersecurity_it_security.label: Cybersecurity & IT Security
cybersecurity_it_security.capital_intensity_basis: Expertise/service-based; minimal fixed assets beyond technical infrastructure access.
cybersecurity_it_security.notes: Audit fix (gap #4/#7): distinct from it_services_outsourcing (general Mercury-Saturn service delivery) -- Ketu is the standard contemporary significator for hidden vulnerabilities/breaches, H6 for defending against covert opponents/threats, H8 for hidden/concealed risk, Saturn for systematic protective discipline.

waste_management_recycling.label: Waste Management & Recycling
waste_management_recycling.capital_intensity_basis: Processing facilities and regulated disposal/recycling infrastructure require substantial upfront capital.
waste_management_recycling.notes: Audit fix (gap #4): Ketu (dissolution, what is discarded/let go) + Saturn (labor, regulation, long-cycle discipline) on H8 (transformation) + H12 (loss, disposal, unseen expenditure) -- previously unrepresented category.

government_contracting_public_sector.label: Government Contracting & Public Sector Business
government_contracting_public_sector.capital_intensity_basis: Bidding/compliance overhead and large-scale project delivery typically require substantial working capital and bonding capacity.
government_contracting_public_sector.notes: Audit fix (gap #5): Sun (government, public authority, official office) appeared in only 4 of 37 sectors, and no sector represented government-facing/public-sector business at all -- the domain most directly tied to Sun's classical significations. H10 (karma/authority/status) + H11 (gains/networks) with Sun-Saturn (authority + institutional discipline) closes this gap.

food_beverage_restaurants.label: Food & Beverage / Restaurants
food_beverage_restaurants.capital_intensity_basis: Kitchen/venue build-out and inventory turnover costs, but not heavy fixed industrial assets.
food_beverage_restaurants.notes: Audit fix (gap #7): previously absorbed into the venue-based hospitality_lifestyle (Venus-only, H7/H11) with no distinct sector for food/beverage production and service specifically. H2 (food, sustenance, accumulated resources) + H6 (daily service/labor) with Moon (nourishment, public taste) + Venus (palatability, hospitality) gives it its own signature, sharing the venus_moon_consumer_goods family with fmcg_consumer_goods and beauty_personal_care.

aviation_aerospace.label: Aviation & Aerospace
aviation_aerospace.capital_intensity_basis: Fleet, regulatory certification, and airport/hangar infrastructure require very substantial upfront capital.
aviation_aerospace.notes: Audit fix (gap #7): previously absorbed into the generic logistics_transportation sector (Mars-Rahu, H3/H9) with no distinction for air/long-distance transport specifically -- H9 (long-distance travel, foreign reach) + H10 (large-scale enterprise/status) with Rahu (altitude, foreign, disruption) + Saturn (heavy regulated infrastructure) closes this gap.

defense_security_services.label: Defense & Security Services
defense_security_services.capital_intensity_basis: Personnel/training-driven for private security services; scales to HIGH for defense manufacturing/contracting specifically, not distinguished at this registry granularity.
defense_security_services.notes: Audit fix (gap #7): private security, guarding, and defense-contracting services -- distinct from manufacturing_industrial/mars_saturn_heavy_industrial (production) and government_contracting_public_sector (broader public-sector business) despite sharing Mars-Saturn, via its own H8 (hidden threats, danger) + H10 (authority, enforcement) house pairing and dedicated family.

maritime_shipping_ports.label: Maritime, Shipping & Ports
maritime_shipping_ports.capital_intensity_basis: Vessels, port infrastructure, and fleet maintenance require very substantial upfront capital.
maritime_shipping_ports.notes: Audit fix (2nd gap-audit pass, item 1): logistics_transportation (Mars-Rahu, H3/H9) reads land/air-leaning; sea trade/shipping/ports is its own large vertical -- Moon (water) + Rahu (foreign/cross-border) on H9 (foreign reach) + H12 (deep water, foreign land) is the classical pairing, previously unrepresented.

jewelry_gems_precious_metals.label: Jewelry, Gems & Precious Metals
jewelry_gems_precious_metals.capital_intensity_basis: Precious-metal/gem inventory carries very high per-unit value, tying up substantial working capital.
jewelry_gems_precious_metals.notes: Audit fix (item 2): H2 (wealth, gems -- classically the house of precious stones) + H7 (trade) with Venus (gems/luxury) + Sun (gold) -- previously absorbed into generic retail/fmcg with no dedicated significator match.

renewable_clean_energy.label: Renewable & Clean Energy
renewable_clean_energy.capital_intensity_basis: Generation infrastructure (solar/wind farms, storage) requires very substantial upfront capital.
renewable_clean_energy.notes: Audit fix (item 3): distinct from energy_production_extraction (Sun-Saturn, fossil/extraction-flavored) -- Sun (power/solar) + Rahu (unconventional/disruptive technology) on H4 (land/resource) + H11 (forward-looking gains) for solar/wind/clean-tech ventures specifically.

advertising_marketing_agencies.label: Advertising & Marketing Agencies
advertising_marketing_agencies.capital_intensity_basis: Primarily talent/service-based; minimal fixed assets beyond creative and media-buying capability.
advertising_marketing_agencies.notes: Audit fix (item 4): distinct from media_creative_business (content production) and publishing_content_creation (authorship) -- advertising is persuasion-through-communication, Mercury (messaging) + Venus (branding/persuasion) + Rahu (digital ad-tech), sharing the ecommerce_digital_retail family since both are Rahu-Venus-Mercury digitally-native businesses.

hr_staffing_recruitment.label: HR, Staffing & Recruitment
hr_staffing_recruitment.capital_intensity_basis: Primarily service/placement-based; minimal fixed assets needed to begin operating.
hr_staffing_recruitment.notes: Audit fix (item 5): people-placement/administration -- Mercury (matching/negotiation) + Saturn (structured process) + Moon (people-reading) on H6 (service/employment) + H7 (placement/deals), distinct from consulting_professional_services' broader advisory signature.

fintech.label: FinTech
fintech.capital_intensity_basis: Digital-first delivery is lower-capex than traditional banking, though regulatory/compliance runway still requires funding.
fintech.notes: Audit fix (item 6): distinct from banking_lending_credit (Saturn-Jupiter, institutional) and tech_startup (generic Rahu-Mercury) -- Rahu (disruption) + Jupiter (finance/commerce wisdom) + Mercury (technical execution) on H2/H11 (wealth/gains), for digital-first financial-services ventures specifically.

edtech.label: EdTech
edtech.capital_intensity_basis: Digital content/platform delivery is comparatively low-capex versus physical campus infrastructure.
edtech.notes: Audit fix (item 7): the digital-delivery counterpart to education_institutions (same H5/H9 houses, same Jupiter-Mercury core) with Rahu added as the disruption/digital-platform significator -- mirrors the tech_startup/it_services_outsourcing split logic applied to education.

gaming_esports.label: Gaming & Esports
gaming_esports.capital_intensity_basis: Platform/development costs scale with production ambition; competitive/esports operations add venue and prize-pool overhead.
gaming_esports.notes: Audit fix (item 8): distinct from tech_startup (generic), entertainment_sports_umbrella, and sports_athletics_business (Sun-Mars, physical competition) -- gaming/esports is a genuine hybrid of Mercury (code/interactivity), Venus (entertainment value), and Rahu (competitive-digital), previously unrepresented by any adjacent sector.

interior_design_architecture.label: Interior Design & Architecture
interior_design_architecture.capital_intensity_basis: Primarily design/planning-expertise-based; minimal fixed assets needed to begin operating.
interior_design_architecture.notes: Audit fix (item 9): sits between real_estate_development_brokerage (sales) and construction_contracting (execution) without being either -- Venus (aesthetics) + Saturn (structural discipline) + Mercury (technical drafting) on H4 (property/space) + H10 (professional career).

chemicals_industrial_materials.label: Chemicals & Industrial Materials
chemicals_industrial_materials.capital_intensity_basis: Processing plants, regulated handling, and safety infrastructure require substantial upfront capital.
chemicals_industrial_materials.notes: Audit fix (item 10): previously forced into manufacturing_industrial or pharma_biotech, neither a clean fit -- Mars (processing/transformation) + Ketu (chemical reaction, catalytic change) on H6 (labor/processing) + H8 (transformation).

event_management_hospitality_services.label: Event Management & Hospitality Services
event_management_hospitality_services.capital_intensity_basis: Project-based service delivery; costs scale with event scale rather than fixed infrastructure.
event_management_hospitality_services.notes: Audit fix (item 11): distinct from venue-based hospitality_lifestyle -- project-based occasion/event delivery, Venus (occasion aesthetics) + Mercury (coordination/logistics) on H5 (celebration) + H11 (guest network/gains).

real_estate_investment_rental_income.label: Real Estate Investment & Rental Income
real_estate_investment_rental_income.capital_intensity_basis: Property acquisition capital is a prerequisite before rental-income generation.
real_estate_investment_rental_income.notes: Audit fix (item 12): distinct from real_estate_development_brokerage (active dealing) and real_estate_construction (building) -- passive holding/rental-income model, Moon (steady recurring income) + Saturn (long-term holding) on H4 (property) + H11 (recurring gains).
